module.offBanner: This module is turned off. You can set everything up first and turn it on when you're ready.

login.subtitle: Log in with Discord to manage your servers.

picker.title: Pick a server
picker.subtitle: Servers where you have the Manage Server permission.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Activity on the server: messages, voice, members coming and going, and when people are active.
overview.trackingOff: Activity tracking is turned off. Turn it on to start collecting data:
overview.activePerDayHint: Wrote or sat in voice at least once
overview.voicePerDay: Hours in voice channels per day

members.title: Members
members.description: Activity per member. "Inactive" = hasn't written or been in voice for {{days}} days (change under Settings).

events.title: Event log
events.description: Everything that happened: joins and leaves, voice channels, levels and moderation. Messages themselves are never stored, only counted.

vars.target: The user picked in the command

levels.description: Members earn XP when they write and level up. Same curve as MEE6, so imported XP gives exactly the same levels.
levels.xpPerMessageHint: Random between min and max, at most once per cooldown.
levels.rewardsHint: Roles given automatically at a certain level.
levels.stackHint: Off = the member only keeps the highest reward role.
levels.removeOnDemoteHint: If an admin lowers someone's level, reward roles above it are removed.
levels.exceptionsHint: No XP in these channels or for these roles.
levels.emptyBody: Import from MEE6 or wait for people to start writing.
levels.newLevelHint: XP is set to the start of that level. Role rewards are synced right away.
levels.resetBody: All XP and levels on the server are deleted. This can't be undone (but you can import from MEE6 again).

import.description: Fetches XP, levels and role rewards from MEE6 so nobody loses their progress. You can run the import several times.
import.step1a: Open the MEE6 dashboard for the server and go to Leaderboard.
import.step1b: Turn on “Make my server's leaderboard public” and save.
import.step1c: Come back here and click Test connection.

modeHints.max: Recommended. Each member gets the higher XP of MEE6 and this bot, so it's safe to run several times.
modeHints.replace: MEE6's XP replaces everything this bot has counted. Use it to start over from MEE6.
modeHints.add: MEE6's XP is added on top of existing XP. Run it only once or XP is doubled.

import.importXpSettings: Import XP per message and multiplier
import.done: Done! {{n}} members and {{rewards}} role rewards imported.
import.otherSettings: Other MEE6 settings (welcome messages, reaction roles, commands etc.) aren't available in any public API. Set them up on each page. For reaction roles you can attach the new module to MEE6's existing message by its message ID, so members' reactions are kept.

welcome.description: Welcome new members, give them roles right away and say goodbye when someone leaves.
welcome.dmHint: Sent straight to the new member.
welcome.defaultHint: Leave a message empty to use the default text in the server's language (shown greyed out).
welcome.autorolesHint: Given to every new member. If the server uses membership screening, roles are given once the member accepts the rules.

rr.description: Members react to a message to get roles. The bot posts and updates the message for you.
rr.published: The message is published in Discord
rr.emptyBody: Create a message, pick emojis and roles, and it's published right away.
rr.confirmDelete: Delete? The bot also deletes its message in Discord.

modeHints.unique: Only one role at a time
modeHints.verify: Verification – the role is never removed

rr.descriptionHint: The role list is added automatically below the text.
rr.attachTitle: Attach to an existing message (e.g. from MEE6)
rr.attachBody: Paste the message ID (right-click the message in Discord → Copy Message ID, needs developer mode). The bot then takes over that message instead of posting a new one, and all existing reactions are kept. Turn off reaction roles in MEE6 first.
rr.emojiTip: Tip: you can use normal emojis like 🔥 or the server's own emojis.

typeHints.buttons: Members click a button. The bot confirms privately which roles they got.
typeHints.select: Members pick roles in a menu. Good for many options, like class or spec.
typeHints.reactions: Classic: members react with an emoji. Works on old MEE6 messages too.

rr.emojiOptional: Emoji is optional for buttons and menus.

moderation.allLogged: Every action is logged as a case.
moderation.logChannelHint: Every case (automod too) is posted here.
moderation.dmHint: Tell them what happened and why.
moderation.immuneHint: Members with these roles can't be warned, timed out, kicked or banned by the bot, and automod ignores them.
moderation.escalationHint: What happens when someone reaches a number of warnings.
moderation.deleteCase: Delete the case (no longer counts as a warning)

automod.description: Removes unwanted content automatically. Members with Manage Messages are never affected. Warnings count towards the escalation under Moderation.
automod.badWordsHint: Use * as a wildcard, e.g. idiot* matches idiots.
automod.wordsHint: Press Enter or comma after each word.
automod.invitesHint: Blocks discord.gg links to other servers.
automod.linksHint: Blocks all links except allowed domains.
automod.capsHint: Messages that are mostly CAPITAL LETTERS.
automod.spamHint: Too many messages in a short time.
automod.timeoutLengthHint: For rules with the timeout action.

serverLog.description: Logs what happens on the server: edited and deleted messages, members, roles, voice, channels and server changes. Pick a channel per category; who did it is looked up in Discord's audit log.
serverLog.channelsHint: Empty = that category isn't logged. Several categories can share a channel. Make the channels private for staff.

categoryHints.roles: Roles given or removed, roles created, changed or deleted
categoryHints.voice: Joining, leaving and switching voice channels
categoryHints.moderation: Bans and timeouts done with Discord's own tools. The bot's own cases go to the moderation log.

serverLog.ignoreBotsHint: Messages and joins from bots aren't logged.
serverLog.ignoredChannelsHint: Nothing from these channels is logged, e.g. spam or bot channels.

commands.saved: The command is saved and shows up in Discord right away
commands.description: Create your own slash commands with replies and role handling. They show up in Discord as soon as you save.
commands.emptyBody: E.g. /rules, /raidtimes or /addons replying with a link.
commands.privateLong: Private reply (only the user sees it)
commands.allowedRolesHint: Empty = everyone may use the command.
commands.allowedChannelsHint: Empty = everywhere. Picking a category includes its channels.

modeHints.channel: Everyone in the channel sees the reply.
modeHints.ephemeral: Only the person who ran the command sees the reply.
modeHints.dm: The reply is sent as a private message.

timers.description: Messages sent automatically, e.g. raid reminders every Wednesday at 19:00. Times are Swedish time.

tempVoice.description: When someone joins a "create" channel they get their own voice channel that disappears when it's empty. The owner controls it with
tempVoice.hubsHint: Voice channels that work like a button, e.g. "➕ Create channel". You can have several, e.g. one per category.
tempVoice.categoryHint: Empty = same category as the create channel.
tempVoice.name: Name of new channels

settings.description: Language, activity tracking and what the bot has done. The bot counts messages and voice time per member and day; message content is never stored.
settings.botLanguageHint: Used for public messages: level-ups, welcome texts, logs. Private replies follow each member's own Discord language.
settings.trackVoice: Count time in voice channels (the AFK channel doesn't count)
settings.inactiveAfterHint: Used by the Inactive filter under Members.
settings.botActionsHint: What the bot did and why something failed, e.g. a role above the bot's own role. Kept for 30 days.
settings.auditLogHint: Who changed what in the dashboard.

profile.description: How the bot looks on this server: name, picture, banner, bio and the colour of its posts. It only changes here – other servers see their own profile.
profile.bioHint: Shown when someone clicks the bot. {{n}} characters left.
profile.colorHint: Used in the bot's embeds: /rank, the leaderboard, reaction roles and more.
profile.imagesHint: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, max {{mb}} MB. Saved as soon as you pick a file.
profile.bannerHint: Wide, about 680×240 px. Without a banner the accent colour is shown.
profile.imageSaved: The picture is updated in Discord

auto.description: Build your own rules: when something happens, check conditions, then do things. Roles, messages, buttons, delays and more.
auto.emptyBody: Start from a template, e.g. a verification button or trial to raider after 14 days.
auto.runLogHint: The latest 100 runs. Skipped runs show which condition stopped them.
auto.confirmDelete: Delete the automation? Delays that are already waiting are cancelled.
auto.memberlessHint: This trigger has no member, so member actions (roles, DM, timeout…) are skipped.
auto.cooldownHint: The rule won't run again for the same member within this time.
auto.limitsHint: Safety limits per run: 20 actions, 10 role changes, 5 messages and 3 DMs. Rules can trigger each other at most 3 levels deep.

triggerHints.member_joined: Runs when someone joins. With membership screening it runs after they accept the rules.
triggerHints.member_left: Runs when someone leaves or is kicked. Only messages work, the member is gone.
triggerHints.message_sent: Bots are ignored. Combine with "message contains" to react to words.
triggerHints.role_added: Also when an admin or another bot gives the role. Empty = any role.
triggerHints.role_removed: Also when an admin or another bot removes the role. Empty = any role.
triggerHints.button_clicked: Post a message with a button that has this key, with "Send message" or the panel below.
triggerHints.select_chosen: Post a menu with this key. Use "Roles from menu" to give a role per choice.
triggerHints.reaction_added: Any message, or a specific one. For simple role menus, Reaction roles is easier.
triggerHints.reaction_removed: Any message, or a specific one.
triggerHints.command_used: Runs after the command's own reply. Create commands under Custom commands.
triggerHints.schedule: Runs at set times, e.g. a raid reminder. No member, so use messages.
triggerHints.inactive: Checked once a day. Runs once per member and inactive period (needs Activity tracking).

f.keyHint: A short name like verify or class. Letters, digits, - and _.
f.commandHint: Pick one of your custom commands.
f.cronHint: minute hour day month weekday, e.g. 45 18 * * 3 = Wednesdays 18:45
f.inactiveFor: Hasn't written or been in voice for
f.mappingHint: Menu value → role. Picked values get their role, the others' roles are removed.
f.replyHint: Works for buttons, menus and commands. Otherwise sent in the channel.
f.deleteHint: Deletes the message that triggered the rule.
f.nicknameHint: Max 32 characters. Doesn't work on the server owner.

panel.openButton: Post a message with this button
panel.openSelect: Post a message with this menu
panel.hint: Posted once. Clicks then run this rule, also after restarts.
panel.fromMapping: Options are pre-filled from "Roles from menu".

sim.intro: Check what would happen for a real member. Nothing is done in Discord.
sim.userIdHint: Right-click the member → Copy User ID (needs developer mode).

reasons.loop: Stopped: rules triggered each other too deep
reasons.rate: Stopped: too many runs on the server this minute

problems.key: Give the trigger a key (letters, digits, - and _)
problems.log: Log to channel: pick a channel and write a text
problems.mapping: Roles from menu: every row needs a value and a role
problems.condRoles: Role condition: pick at least one role

verify.name: Verification button
verify.body: A button that gives the member role. Post it in #rules.

classPicker.name: Pick your role: Tank / Healer / DPS
classPicker.body: A menu where each choice gives a role and the others are removed.

trial.name: Trial period
trial.body: When someone gets Trial, wait 14 days and post a reminder to officers.

roleSync.name: Role sync
roleSync.body: When a role is given, give another one too, e.g. Raider → Guild member.

inactive.name: Inactivity demotion
inactive.body: After 30 inactive days: swap the role and log it.

welcomeDm.name: Delayed welcome DM
welcomeDm.body: Send a DM with useful links 10 minutes after joining.

levelReward.name: Level reward with shout-out
levelReward.body: At level 20: give a role and announce it.

apply.name: Application command
apply.body: When /apply is used: reply privately and notify officers.
